rows.label: Tax status: mirror code of the US Internal Revenue Code; US FICA and FUTA apply
rows.value: The US Virgin Islands has its own income tax system under a mirror code: the US Internal Revenue Code applies with 'Virgin Islands' in place of 'United States', with the same tax laws and rates, administered by the Virgin Islands Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR). Bona fide residents file their income tax returns with the BIR, not the IRS. US federal social security and Medicare (FICA, self-employment tax) and FUTA apply; the territory levies its own gross receipts, excise and other local taxes.

source.title: Publication 570 (2025), Tax Guide for Individuals With Income From U.S. Territories
